Bangalore

Professional Summary
Java developer with a focus on building resilient backend systems and scalable microservices. Experienced in designing and implementing REST APIs, optimizing data access with Hibernate, and integrating event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka. Comfortable working on Linux-based deployments and relational databases.

Technical Skills
Java, SpringBoot, Microservices, MySQL, Apache Kafka, Hibernate, REST APIs, Linux

Work Experience
Java Developer, NimbusSoft (Jan 2026 - Present)
- Implemented Spring Boot microservices for a customer billing module, using Hibernate for data persistence to MySQL and delivering REST APIs consumed by frontend and partner services.
- Designed and optimized Kafka producers to stream billing events, reducing end-to-end processing latency by 30% in peak windows.
- Developed Java-based batch processors on Linux to reconcile transactions, improving nightly throughput and lowering error rates through tighter transaction handling.

Software Engineer, Quanta Retail (May 2021 - Dec 2025)
- Built and maintained microservices in Java and SpringBoot that powered inventory and order fulfillment; exposed robust REST APIs for internal and third-party integrations.
- Implemented Hibernate mappings and query optimizations for large product catalogs in MySQL, cutting average query time by 40%.
- Integrated Apache Kafka for event-driven inventory updates and order notifications, enabling near-real-time synchronization across services and reducing out-of-stock incidents.
- Deployed and debugged services on Linux servers, participating in CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth releases.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
